title: Microsoft Teams to get AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection
description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection feature starting in early November 2026. This feature aims to identify phishing, social engineering, impersonation attempts, and deceptive intent by analyzing conversation context, particularly focusing on external first-contact chats. The system does not retain message content for AI training or other secondary uses and requires no action from IT administrators to enable. This enhancement is part of a broader set of security improvements in Teams designed to reduce phishing and fraud risks.
